# Dubbo Skip Bins

> Skip bins in Dubbo, West Dubbo, Wellington and surrounds. Tell us the size and waste type and get a free quote from one local skip bin operator.

Dubbo Skip Bins (dubboskipbins.com) is a free skip bin quote and referral service, not a skip hire company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, skip size, waste type, then contact details) and the request goes to one local skip bin operator, who quotes, supplies the skip and sets the price and hire terms.

- Service: skip bin hire quotes
- Area: Dubbo, Dubbo Regional Council (NSW), including West Dubbo, South Dubbo, East Dubbo, Delroy Park, Keswick Estate, Southlakes Estate, Brocklehurst, Wongarbon, Eumungerie, Mogriguy, Ballimore, Rawsonville, Toongi, Wellington, Geurie, Stuart Town
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Dubbo Skip Bins cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take skip bin quote requests from Dubbo and nearby areas, including West Dubbo, South Dubbo, East Dubbo, Delroy Park, Keswick Estate, Southlakes Estate, Brocklehurst, Wongarbon, Eumungerie, Mogriguy, Ballimore, Rawsonville, Toongi, Wellington, Geurie, Stuart Town. The quote service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. The operator includes delivery and pick-up in its quote. Rural deliveries to Ballimore, Stuart Town or Eumungerie, extra hire days and difficult access can add to the price.
- **Do I need a licence or permit for a skip bin?** You don't need a licence to hire a skip. A skip wholly on your own property generally doesn't need approval. On a road, footpath or nature strip, Dubbo Regional Council requires an "Approval to Place a Skip Bin in a Public Place" under section 68. Its 2025–26 fees list a $185 application fee and $1,029 per month land rental. Call council on 02 6801 4000. Asbestos is different: asbestos can't go in a general skip. More than 10 m² of bonded asbestos must be removed by a licensed removalist in NSW.
- **What affects the price of a skip bin?** Skip bin prices depend on the bin size, the type and weight of the waste, how long you keep the bin, how far the truck travels and how easy access is. We don't publish a price list. Tell us about your job and a local operator will quote for it.
- **Who supplies the skip?** Dubbo Skip Bins is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't own skips or trucks. We pass your request to one local skip bin operator who services your area, and they quote, supply the skip and set the hire terms.
